description: Deterministic tests for pr-review-bot's bundled scripts. The pure helpers (target parsing) run offline; the gh/GraphQL-dependent exit-code contracts require auth + a real PR and are declared manual (SKIPPED, never counted as passed). Placeholders {scripts} are substituted by run-tests.py. Requires bash on PATH.

tests.description: prb_parse_target extracts owner/repo/number from a PR URL.
prb_parse_target passes through the explicit owner/repo/number form.
prb_parse_target tolerates a scheme-less github.com URL.
prb_parse_target fails loudly (exit != 0) on an unparseable target.

Requires gh auth + real PRs: fetch-pr.sh returns 2 on a merged PR, 3 on closed, 4 on an own PR (PRB_ME_OVERRIDE=<author>), 5 when PRB_REPO_ALLOWLIST excludes the repo, 0 otherwise. Run by hand against a known PR.
Requires gh auth + a real reviewed PR: check-addressed.sh returns 0 when all bot threads resolved, 2 (PRB_REASON=...) otherwise; approve.sh posts an APPROVE-only review. Run by hand.
